In those paths, if can_use_umr_rereg_access returns true, umr_rereg_pd_access is called, which updates the MR’s access flags via UMR without re-pinning the umem (lines 'err = umr_rereg_pd_access(mr, new_pd, new_access_flags);'). If that condition fails, the code calls create_real_mr with the old umem and new access flags, again without re-pinning (line 'return create_real_mr(new_pd, umem, mr->mmkey.iova, new_access_flags);').
